text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Nice! Summer training camp, huh! A voyage 
gets boring if it's all one note!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Going ashore once in a while isn't so 
bad. Indeed, at this port we stopped 
by..."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure there's a bustling town just like 
this! Sailors singing out loud, and then—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"We're gonna dance the night away! Yeah! 
This is the ultimate vacation, Trainer!"
choice_data_list:
No, there isn't really a downtown area 
around here, though...

No, there isn't really an entertainment 
district, but...

text_block_list.text:
"You seem to be under a misconception. 
Summer camp is by no means 'all hands 
stand down.'"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: "There isn't? Well, whatever."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
So Trainer, how are the base-building 
preparations coming along?! How's 
everything looking?
choice_data_list:
Yeah, things are going completely smoothly 
over there.

Yeah, that part is going completely 
smoothly.

text_block_list.text:
Her abilities are improving, and plans for 
how to design the base's interior and 
exterior are gradually taking shape.
choice_data_list: Everything should be ready by year's end!

Everything should be ready by the end of 
the year!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Haha, got it! Alright everyone, let's keep 
going at this rate!

text_block_list.name: 2 Fellow Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah……

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Wait, huh? There are only Umamusume here. 
Where's everyone else?

text_block_list.name: Headband Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
The other girls couldn't make it to the 
training camp... Paying out of pocket is 
just way too much~.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in Sunglasses
text_block_list.text:
You mentioned having summer classes too, 
right? And packed ones at that...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I see. Well, it can't be helped. In that 
case—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Let's go all-out, just the two of us! 
Headin' straight into autumn, yeah!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
If we want to make our base even more 
lavish, we've gotta double, triple, 
quadruple our momentum!

text_block_list.name: Headband Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... gotta do my best~... I need to at 
least get a clear path to my debut 
somehow...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in Sunglasses
text_block_list.text:
Somehow, I must win... in this summer 
race...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hm? What's with those gloomy looks on your 
faces? Don't tell me—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Suffering from summer fatigue? Then I'll 
whip up my special paella for ya to eat!

For now, it was smooth sailing. Nothing 
stood in the way of Tap Dance City's 
course, but...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...... Augh, such a drag. Still...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
No choice, I guess. If I don't go now, 
it'll hurt my chances in the autumn...

This summer, there seemed to be several 
developments among the Umamusume of my 
generation.
